optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Implementation Project Manager, Fleet Telematics Service

professionalSummary.text: Managed pre-implementation pilot programmes for six prospective logistics customers on the fleet telematics service, including tenant configuration, pilot delivery, and pilot-device installation scheduling.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the pre-implementation pilot programme for the fleet telematics service, configuring the demonstration tenant for six prospective logistics customers and running a two-week pilot with each customer's pilot vehicles.

professionalSummary.text: Documented pilot limitations, configuration questions, and hand-over conditions in pilot reports and implementation plans for each customer.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the pilot report and the implementation plan handed to the delivery team for each customer, listing the demonstration tenant's limitations, open configuration questions and the hand-over conditions.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated pilot device installation schedules with the field engineering partner for pilot vehicles only.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the installation of pilot devices on each customer's pilot vehicles with the field engineering partner, keeping the installation schedule for the pilot vehicles only.

experienceHighlights.text: Did not participate in cut-over to live operation, full fleet device installation, or hypercare period; these stages were managed by delivery team implementation leads after contract signing.
experienceHighlights.witness: The cut-over to live operation, the device installation across each customer's full fleet and the hypercare period were run by the delivery team's implementation leads after the contract was signed; I did not take part in those stages.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Pilot report and implementation plan for one regional carrier, including demonstration tenant configuration identifiers and pilot vehicle list as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the pilot report and implementation plan for one regional carrier, with the demonstration tenant's configuration identifiers and the pilot vehicle list as a verification trail.

skills.text: Pilot programme management for fleet telematics service, including tenant configuration, pilot delivery, and pilot-device installation scheduling.
skills.witness: About three years on the pilot programme covered tenant configuration, pilot delivery, pilot-device installation scheduling, pilot reports and implementation plans for prospective customers.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role in pilot programmes but do not establish involvement in cut-overs, full fleet deployments, or hypercare periods. The candidate's claims about bringing fleets live and running cut-overs are contradicted by the materials.
